hw.label: estimated
hw.text: No measured hardware profile for these cards yet: memory sizes and bandwidth are catalog (datasheet) values, rates are borrowed from the nearest measured card. Every figure below is an estimate; the first boot on this hardware is the measurement.

per card outside the pool: 6 x 4784 MiB (graphs, activations, reserves; derived from the dry run) = 28.0 GiB
needed 39.9 GiB against 144.0 GiB available: margin 104.1 GiB
layouts.name: Solo (TP only)
layouts.satz: All cards work as one tensor-parallel group that prefills and decodes; no switching, no front.
why: 6 cards: no release boot has proven this card count on metal yet (the named blocker METAL-UNPROVEN). The numbers come from the launcher dry run; the launcher takes this layout only with force, and the first boot is the proof.

The release profile for this model on 6 cards of this kind is marked blocked (D-BUDGET): the launcher's decode-ownership solver (D-EIGENTUM, #239 S3f) finds no sustainable distribution, and even with force it only passes the D-BUDGET refusal by name. Not startable yet; the cause is open.

Memory is not the limit: the rough calculation below leaves a margin of 104.1 GiB, and the launcher's per-rank memory checks of the profile (W122/W130) pass on every rank. What fails is the ownership search of the decode group: no form with an edge on every rank and without more misses of a worker than form A.
